purpose: Test singularity-aligned volume integration and enrichment-front offset on the frozen 162-DOF full 3-D operator; this is not a physical crack-growth or material-qualification study.

immutable_upstream.mutation_policy: Read-only reference only; the frozen operator case, provider, result, replay, source pins, and prior receipts are never edited or reused as cached query values.

geometry_and_physics.physical_domain: x^2+y^2 <= R^2, -L/2 <= z <= L/2; cylinder remains centered at the old origin
geometry_and_physics.offset_interpretation: a changes the center and branch of the trial FRONT_F1 basis and defines a manually specified candidate crack-front offset. The old-tip analytic field, KIII, exterior traction function, physical cylinder, and source grid stay fixed as fixed-load reanalysis data. a=0.5 mm is not a manufactured exact solution at the candidate shifted front; no crack state is committed, propagated autonomously, or qualified against a material model.
geometry_and_physics.crack_and_branch_warning: The candidate branch/crack surface extends along y=0 for x<a, including a=0.5 mm. The old-tip manufactured field is an exact comparison only at a=0; for a>0 the true solution is unknown. The prescribed old-tip exterior traction remains a legitimate fixed-load reanalysis input. No bulk quadrature rows are placed on the zero-measure crack surface, and no shifted exact-field error is reported.

material_benchmark.exact_stress: sigma_xz=sigma_zx=mu*duz/dx; sigma_yz=sigma_zy=mu*duz/dy; all other components zero
material_benchmark.boundary_traction: The same old-tip exact full stress dotted with each physical exterior normal in every case; KIII is not altered or fitted to a quadrature rule.
material_benchmark.G_comparison_limit: The exact 0.013 is an old-tip local/asymptotic reference. The finite-delta-a energy difference below is a different quantity; do not use percent error to 0.013 as its pass criterion.

operator_and_dofs.basis: continuous 3-D linear MLS with BASE and global normalized F1; only F1's analytic center is shifted by a
operator_and_dofs.operator: K=sum_q B(q)^T D B(q) w_q, engineering strain [exx,eyy,ezz,gammaxy,gammayz,gammaxz], full isotropic lambda-mu D
operator_and_dofs.assembly_plan: Use the frozen full3d assembler unchanged on sequential volume chunks of at most 256 rows; sum the returned raw 162x162 K chunks in deterministic order.
operator_and_dofs.rigid_modes: The same six BASE-only translations and rotations; every FRONT_F1 coefficient is zero. No ridge, pseudoinverse, projection, or eigenvalue truncation.

volume_rule.branch_and_front_rule: Open Gauss nodes only; no epsilon nudges, branch-face points, or singular-tip points. This is still finite quadrature over the full domain, not a radial hole.

side.reason: Keep the discretized exterior side load fixed while the volume theta rule changes. Side query coordinates are newly evaluated once in this study and the raw MLS/reference rows are then specialized for each a.

end_caps.traction_field: Old-tip exact full stress times top/bottom normal; top t=(mu*duz/dx,mu*duz/dy,0), bottom t=(-mu*duz/dx,-mu*duz/dy,0).
end_caps.polar_center: old physical tip (0,0); one shared cap point cloud for both trial enrichment offsets
end_caps.load_policy: The physical cap points, normals, area weights, and old-tip traction are identical for both trial offsets. For each a, save coarse and fine cap generalized loads/wrenches/work; use fine-16-per-semicircle cap load in every solve. Side rule is the same across volume theta orders. Report coarse-to-fine load change; do not alter KIII or force-fit g.

fixed_physical_gauge.definition: Six volume moments using translations and omega cross (x-volume_centroid)/R; compute C from each case's own volume rows and weights.
fixed_physical_gauge.target_formula: g=[0,0,0,A*sqrt(R)*16/(21*pi),0,0] m for every one of the four cases
fixed_physical_gauge.interpretation: The new target is the closed-form physical moment, fixed across all cases; it differs slightly from the old finite-theta saved target. This changes the numerical gauge reference by a known small amount, not the physical traction or KIII.

offgrid_rule.purpose: Independent displacement, gradient, stress, and spurious-normal-stress comparison; not reused from the prior 384-location result.
offgrid_rule.shifted_case_policy: At a=0 compare to old-tip exact field. At a=0.5 mm report solved-field change relative to the a=0 solution on these same physical locations; do not report a shifted exact-field error.

query_budget.physical_xyz_uniqueness: Generate all declared points, then exact-deduplicate global xyz before the first MLS/reference call. Record requested rows and measured unique xyz count separately. Do not claim the cross-a volume intersection count before point generation; never call prior saved arrays a cache for these points.

per_case: six/156 full-K spectrum, rigid-mode null residuals, and KTT consistency
exact coefficient field energy and solved U=0.5*d^T*K*d
external W=d^T*f and constrained energy identity 2U-W=-g^T*lambda
weighted relative displacement/gradient/stress error versus old-tip exact field only for a=0
volume-weighted spurious normal/shear stress ratio and max absolute sigma_yy; shifted a case is labeled as a numerical change, not exact error
side/top/bottom/total force, moment, rigid virtual work, and cap traction/work for both cap theta rules
coarse-to-fine cap generalized-load and wrench change
cross_case: within each volume theta order, delta-a finite potential difference G=-[Pi(a=0.5mm)-Pi(a=0)]/(L*0.5mm), Pi=U-W
theta32-to-theta64 changes at fixed a and fixed fine boundary load
exact old-tip local G=0.013 J/m^2 is listed as an asymptotic reference only; the finite delta-a G is not required to converge to it
requested_diagnostics.deferred: No J contour samples or J-integral implementation in this first study; revisit G contours only after volume field precision is acceptable.

numerical_trust_gates.interpretation: fixed-front algebraic consistency gates, not physical accuracy or fracture acceptance criteria

mechanical_spectrum_gates.mls_condition_number_policy: record and enforce only through the provider's own qualification; never relax mechanical tolerances
mechanical_spectrum_gates.interpretation: engineering numerical gates only; the scaled eigenspectrum check is not a strict eigenvalue proof

limitations: At a=0.5 mm the candidate crack surface extends from x<0 to x<a. The old-tip manufactured field is exact only at a=0; the shifted case is a manual fixed-load candidate reanalysis with unknown true solution, not a committed crack state, autonomous growth result, or material qualification.

The shared cap map splits the old-tip radial coordinate at c=0.5 mm, matching the shifted trial-tip radius while keeping identical physical cap points for both a values. Inner and outer maps focus radial points around both the old traction singularity and the shifted basis singularity; finite GL4 radial and GL8/GL16 angular rules still provide no certified error bound.
Two volume theta rules provide a controlled integration comparison, not a proof of convergence.
Linear small-strain elasticity is a near-tip LEFM idealization; no finite-strain or material-core model is included.
E, nu, KIII, and all reported energies are synthetic benchmark quantities, not ceramic material calibration.
